native_oracles.inherited_oracles: All v2 native obligations remain required

pairs.positive: Full actual original append acknowledgement and source group
pairs.negative: Receipt group/ack changes without its actual original owner

pairs.positive: Exact original B1 writer request record and transaction
pairs.negative: Repaired writer/preflight or unrelated B1 transaction

pairs.positive: Exact actual original permission and confirmation sources
Complete original B3 operation/result source and current read
pairs.negative: B3 identity or canonical result hash/fence mismatch

pairs.positive: Hold added after B1 remains in actual B3 read snapshot
pairs.negative: B3 attempts a point write or weakens pre-B1 admission

pairs.positive: Actual different acknowledgement within lawful original bounds
pairs.negative: Caller timestamp changes without corresponding owner source

pairs.positive: Source relocated while original controls remain preserved
pairs.negative: Current coordinates replace original source controls

pairs.positive: Actual already-admitted immutable companion/result and current source verify after all original transient controls have retired
pairs.negative: Self-issued or transplanted retained rows, repaired hashes or unadmitted store origin cannot authenticate ordinary history

pairs.positive: The same actual complete read/retirement authority lease remains valid through final disclosure or handoff
pairs.negative: Late registration/installation/origin/permission/source or hold/age/count changes invalidate publication

phase_qualification: Initial native admission, fresh lifecycle admission, admitted pending recovery and later retained reads use their explicit SP-285 routes; SP-286 first receipt is adopted. Static future-trace preludes do not execute native B1/E1 ordering. Native remains NOT_RUN.
